name: Quant
rootCause: Quant’s Ethereum reserve pool was exploited on 28 April 2026 due to a failure in access control. An externally owned admin account was routed through a public batch-execution path, allowing an attacker to drain 1,974.5 QNT tokens (about $138,000) in a single transaction. The QNT reserve pool’s administrative authority was delegated to an externally owned account (EOA). This EOA could be targeted via a public batch-routing mechanism that lacked an effective access control boundary, allowing arbitrary external calls by anyone able to trigger the batch route. As a result, an attacker executed a privileged withdrawal and drained almost all pooled QNT tokens.
